comment: Karma tests that do not pass on the Jenkins agent today, with the reason.
ci/baseline.mjs rewrites them as skipped in the JUnit report, so the job
goes red on a NEW failure rather than on the backlog it inherited.
Keyed by the test name as karma writes it. Two guards: an entry that starts
passing is reported as a failure, so the list cannot rot; and if every
failure in a run is on the list AND nothing passed, the run fails anyway.

known.#libutvideo should decode testcard.avi w: avidmx cannot open the downloaded file: its gmem blob is flagged GF_BLOB_CORRUPTED (flags 0x2) although it holds the whole 654386 bytes. Not a network problem - the same file downloads in 15 ms with curl from a pod in this cluster - and not /dev/shm, which --disable-dev-shm-usage did not change. GF_EOS is only ever concluded from total_size == bytes_done in downloader_emscripten.c, so a download the fetcher finished without a usable total_size lands in the error branch and the complete blob is declared corrupted. Under investigation; an instrument printing fetch_err, bytes_done and total_size is ready.
known.#mjpeg should decode testcard.avi with w: Same cause as #libutvideo, on the 323112-byte MJPEG AVI.
known.#libvpx should decode UshaikaRiverEmb_64: Same cause as #libutvideo, on the 1729334-byte VP9 WebM, through webmdmx rather than avidmx.
known.#libheif should decode example_flower_he: 60 s timeout with no assertion. The failure signature differs from the three above - a TypeError in reportUndefinedSymbols, which is the same crash the Showcase avif and midi demos hit when an accessor wants a symbol the solver does not export. Not yet diagnosed.
